townsend_reference.linear_strain_part: (-gamma y1, gamma y2, 0) notin L3(R^3) (diverges as |y| -> infinity)
townsend_reference.vortical_core_part: (0, 0, f(y1)) with f'(y1) = w0 exp(-gamma y1^2 / (2 nu)) in L_loc^3
townsend_reference.mathematical_resolution: Convergence must be interpreted strictly as CORE PROFILE CONVERGENCE (or local L3(B_R) convergence), NOT global full-field L3(R^3) convergence.

burgers_reference.velocity_formula: u(y) = (-alpha/2 y1, -alpha/2 y2, alpha y3) + u_theta
